correctness.rationale: For \(m=pq\), Knödel membership is equivalent to \(\operatorname{lcm}(p-1,q-1)\mid pq-k\). The two reduced divisibilities force \(p=k\) or \(p<q<k\), yielding the exact classification. Dirichlet's theorem and the prime number theorem for arithmetic progressions give the infinite family and asymptotic for prime \(k\).
